column1: # These are forms the FST analyses WRONGLY. They are false positives, not gaps, so a
# fallback layer that only fills `+?` never sees them:
#     அல்ல   -> அல்லு+verb+nonfin+sim+inf=அ      (spurious verb 'அல்லு'; அல்ல is the negative copula)
#     அன்று  -> அன்று+verb+fin+sim+imp=∅+2sg=∅   (imperative of a verb; அன்று is neg copula / 'that day')
#     கிடையாது -> கிடையா+verb+nonfin+sim+vpart    (no negation marker at all)
# Getting this wrong means the negation slot silently scores garbage while every coverage
# mode = replace : discard the FST analyses entirely, use this one.
# mode = augment : keep the FST analyses, merge these slot features into each.
# ⚠ EVERY ROW ENCODES A GRAMMATICAL CLAIM and is a judgment call pending
# native-speaker audit. R5's treatment of அன்று as copular (it is also the
# noun 'that day') and R9's honorific reading of தாங்கள் are the two most contestable.

column9: negative copula; also noun 'that day' — judgment call
